record.question: Various activities of a project, are shown on bar charts by -
record.explanation: In a project bar/Gantt chart, tasks run down the page and time runs horizontally. Each activity’s start-to-finish duration is represented by a horizontal bar. Reference: https://learninglab.rmit.edu.au/Toolbox/buildright/content/bcgbc4007a/03_develop_track_revise/05_bar_gantt_charts/page_001.htm; https://library.iitd.ac.in/NPTEL2024/Week8-Lec-28.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
